text:
🌿 We're hiring! Join our kindergarten team in Tel Aviv! 🌿
A few months ago, I posted here looking for people to join our team, and we were lucky enough to meet some truly wonderful people through this group. So I thought I'd try my luck again! 😊

My partner and I run a warm, English-speaking kindergarten in the heart of Tel Aviv, and we're looking for someone caring, responsible, and enthusiastic to join our team.

We have a lovely international team, and as several of us have experienced the immigration process ourselves, we understand the challenges of starting a new life in Israel.

Experience with young children is a plus, but finding the right person matters most to us!

✨ Sunday–Thursday + one Friday a month

✨ Good working conditions

✨ A warm, supportive team

We're looking for someone who wants to grow with us and hopefully stay for the long term.

Interested? Send me a private message! 💚
